stage.label: 01 Transfer Image To Blueprint
stage.summary: Convert the input image into a validated Minecraft blueprint with three visible tool calls.

children.label: receive image
children.summary: The image is handed to ProjectManager and Designer.

children.label: convert blueprint
children.summary: Designer runs the compact image-to-blueprint tool chain.

events.action: Request compact blueprint conversion from Designer.
sublines: send_msg: [Designer, convert image to buildable blueprint, image path: construction_image.png] -> success
tool_call: TRELLIS.2[construction_image.png] -> success, model path: xini_model.obj
log: reconstruction summary -> main volume detected, silhouette preserved, scale normalized

events.action: Convert the model into a Minecraft blueprint.
sublines: tool_call: Model To Blueprint[xini_model.obj] -> success, blueprint path: xini.json
log: conversion summary -> schematic generated, block palette mapped, empty space removed

events.action: Validate the blueprint before ProjectManager planning.
sublines: tool_call: Validate Blueprint[xini.json] -> success, 95,151 blocks, 52 active levels, bounds x[-60,30] z[6,148]
log: blueprint status -> ready for regional split
send_msg: [ProjectManager, blueprint complete, blueprint path: xini.json] -> success
